explanation: Sweden's parliament passed the act in 1766, abolishing most censorship of printed works. The US First Amendment, which protects a free press, was ratified in 1791.

claims.text: Sweden's Freedom of the Press Act was passed by the Riksdag in 1766.
The First Amendment to the US Constitution was ratified on 15 December 1791, as part of the Bill of Rights.

The First Amendment protects the freedom of the press.
